title: Microservices Patterns
description: Learn microservices decomposition strategies, communication patterns, service discovery, and how to avoid distributed monoliths.

data.text: Microservices decompose applications into small, independent services. This improves scalability and deployment flexibility but adds complexity in communication, data consistency, and operations.

cards.title: Monolith
cards.description: Single deployable unit with shared database. Simpler to develop initially, harder to scale independently.

cards.title: Microservices
cards.description: Independent services with own databases. Complex to manage but enables independent scaling and deployment.

data.text: Decompose by domain-driven design bounded contexts. Avoid拆分 too early - start with a modular monolith and extract services when clear boundaries emerge.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Microservices trade operational complexity for deployment flexibility
Decompose by bounded contexts, not technical layers
Start with modular monolith, extract when boundaries are clear
Avoid distributed monolith - services must be truly independent
Service discovery is essential for dynamic service resolution
data.takeaway: Microservices are not a silver bullet. Use them when you need independent scaling and deployment, not by default. Proper decomposition is critical to avoid creating a distributed monolith.
